VI.description: DQMH 7.x VARIANT of lvdqmh_rename_event.vi - the same pane and behaviour against Delacor's 7.x scripting layout\3A the shared scripting VIs live in dqmh_lib_DQMH Scripting Support.lvlib under vi.lib and call their input error in. Rename Event.vi names its module input Module Info in and has a REQUIRED Desc in 7.x - the event's description\2C which Delacor's dialog pre-fills from the event VI and lets the user edit. Event Description does the same here\3A empty keeps the event VI's own description\2C read with Get VI.Description.\0A\0AHeadless DQMH Rename Event. Renames ONE event of ONE DQMH module in the ACTIVE project by calling Delacor's own scripting VIs as STATIC subVIs - the chain Delacor's Event\5CRename DQMH Event.vi runs behind its dialog\2C with no dialog and no keystroke.\0A\0AChain\3A lvdqmh_pick_event.vi (parse\2C pick module and event by NAME\2C close the other modules) -> Project\3AActive Project -> Rename Event.vi -> lvdqmh_close_modules.vi. Rename Event.vi saves the project and closes the project reference it is given\2C as it does under Delacor's dialog.\0A\0AWHY ONE HIERARCHY. Module Info carries thirteen refnums that LabVIEW releases when the top-level VI that opened them stops\2C so the parse and the scripter must run under one top-level VI.\0A\0ADRY RUN BY DEFAULT. Script? FALSE parses and reports only. Scripting also needs the module and the event found\2C no locked and no unsaved module - Delacor's rename dialog refuses unsaved modules too - and no error. Not found is not an error\3A Module Index or Event Index -1. Scripted? says whether Rename Event.vi was called.\0A\0ANO MODAL DIALOG ON PURPOSE. Delacor's dialog checks New Event Name with Verify Event Names.vi and One Button Dialogs\3B a modal stops LabVIEW's gRPC service\2C so those checks are NOT made here. The caller must refuse a blank or invalid name\2C and a name whose .vi already exists in Library Owning Folder\2C before Script? is TRUE. Rename Event.vi is never handed an incoming error.\0A\0ARequires DQMH installed\2C a project OPEN AND ACTIVE in the IDE\2C and lvdqmh_pick_event.vi and lvdqmh_close_modules.vi loaded. Generated by LabVIEWMCP\3B the Delacor VIs it calls belong to the user's DQMH installation and are not shipped with it.
